_comment: Pre-rendered Jarvis phrases in whichever voice you render them in.
The collector serves one of these from memory when a /v1/jarvis/tts
sentence matches an entry's text -- see jarvis_canned_key for what
'matches' means. Every text below is ONE sentence, because the console's
extractor feeds the route one sentence at a time and a two-sentence
entry would never be asked for.
REGENERATING THE SHELF. No audio ships with this repo -- the manifest
is the list of phrases, not a promise that the wavs exist. Render each
`text` below to the `file` beside it with any Kokoro-class TTS, at a
natural pace, and keep one voice across the whole set; the voice only
has to match itself, since every phrase not on the shelf is spoken by
the TTS host anyway. Until then the collector logs `canned clips not
rendered` once at startup and sends every sentence to the TTS host,
which is the feature switched off rather than broken. To add a clip:
render the wav here, add its entry, deploy. Nothing else reads this

clips.text: Good morning sir, would you like me to tell you about your Daily CMO?
Just a moment while I look into that.
I'm afraid something has gone wrong.
My apologies sir, I was unable to complete that request.
